Your Credential

What Is an Enrolled Agent?

An Enrolled Agent (EA) is the IRS's highest credential for tax professionals — federally licensed by the U.S. Department of the Treasury, not limited to a single state the way a CPA license is.

Licensed by the IRS

Enrolled to practice before the IRS by the U.S. Department of the Treasury — not licensed state by state like a CPA.

Earned Through Rigorous Testing

EA status requires passing a comprehensive three-part IRS exam covering individual returns, business returns, and representation.

Unlimited Representation Rights

Can represent taxpayers before the IRS in audits, collections, and appeals — a right shared only with attorneys and CPAs.

Nationwide, Ongoing Education

Must complete continuing education to keep the license active, and can practice before the IRS in any state.

Enrolled Agent (EA) · Enrollment No. 00172538-EA

Get Ready

What to Bring to Your Appointment

Having These on Hand Makes Your Filing Faster and More Accurate.

For Individuals
  • Photo Id
  • Social Security Card or ITIN
  • Prior-Year Tax Return (if Available)
  • W-2s and 1099s
  • Deductible Expense Records (Mortgage Interest, Medical, Charitable Donations)
  • Health Coverage Forms (1095-A/B/C), if Applicable
For Businesses
  • Business Formation Documents
  • Profit & Loss Statement
  • Business Expense Records
  • Prior-Year Business Return (if Available)
  • Payroll Records, if You Have Employees

Frequently Asked Questions

What Is an Enrolled Agent (EA)?

An Enrolled Agent is a tax practitioner licensed by the U.S. Department of the Treasury with unlimited rights to represent taxpayers before the IRS — the IRS's highest credential for tax professionals.

Are You a CPA?

No — Arun is an IRS Enrolled Agent (EA), a federal tax credential focused specifically on taxation, with unlimited rights to represent clients before the IRS nationwide.

Can You Represent Me if I Get an IRS Audit or Notice?

Yes. As an Enrolled Agent, Arun can represent you directly before the IRS for audits, notices, and collections.

Do You File Taxes Outside of California?

Yes — We File Federal and State Returns for Clients Nationwide, in All 50 States.

Can You Help Me Apply for an ITIN?

Yes, We Assist with New ITIN Applications for Individuals Without a Social Security Number.

Do You Prepare Business Tax Returns?

Yes, for Sole Proprietors, Partnerships, and Small Businesses.

What if I Haven't Filed in a Few Years?

We Can Help with Prior-Year and Back-Tax Return Preparation.

Do You Speak Punjabi or Hindi?

Yes, We Explain Your Return Clearly in English, Punjabi, or Hindi.

Can You Also Help with My Insurance?

Yes — Visit Our Insurance Page for Auto, Home, Commercial, Trucking, Life, and Health Coverage.
